in_marathi.name: Akhileshwar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Immeasurable, Invincible God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Akhileshwar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Akhileshwar is a compound of two words: 'Akhi' meaning immeasurable and 'Ishwar' meaning god. Thus, Akhileshwar can be interpreted as 'God who is invincible and beyond all measure'. In Hindu mythology, Lord Akhileshwar is considered to be an incarnation of Lord Shiva.
